narrative.overview: Code-led documentation of the incumbent warm ivory, forest, restrained blush and editorial serif system. Bouquet photography supplies most color; readable Vietnamese text and compact evidence labels support discovery and catalog operations. Research extends the same Studio shell through native controls, ruled rows and flat evidence inspectors. No approved visual comp or replacement identity is recorded.
keyCharacteristics: Photo-forward catalog with softly rounded image frames.
Forest controls, ivory canvas and fine neutral rules.
Expressive headings paired with compact evidence labels.
Research actions remain adjacent to their evidence and explicit readiness state.

rules.name: The Photography Rule
rules.body: Let bouquet images carry varied color; preserve the restrained botanical interface around them.

dos: Do preserve the original finding your flowers tagline and self-hosted font pair.
Do keep loading, unknown, stale, unconfigured, synthetic, under-sampled and approved evidence states explicit.
Do preserve unsaved local research state during workspace switches; leaving the outer Research tab does not provide draft persistence.
Do use contained evidence images, wrapping identifiers and locally scrolling proof tables.
donts: Don't visually conflate recommendations with qualified price benchmarks.
Don't imply that extraction review verifies inventory or synthetic evaluation establishes live quality.
Don't turn scoped research finish evidence into a whole-application visual or accessibility certification.
Don't claim seller-summary visual validation; that extension was reviewed from code only.
